text: You coached a stranger for fucking free in your DMs again, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you, landing hard on 'again'.

text: One quick question, bro. Then his diet, his training split, his sleep.
style: Outraged and fed up, a casual American guy venting to his buddy, speeding up through the list.

text: So you typed him a full program. With your thumbs.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, a small beat before the last three words.

text: He said he'll think about it. Never heard from him again.
style: Deflated and bitter, the second sentence flat and tired.

text: And how did that make you feel?
style: Calm, slow and soft, a fake therapist voice, completely deadpan.

text: Five hours this week. Teens who can't pay, a guy who literally doesn't want to.
style: Venting, exasperated, hitting 'five hours', then listing fast like a confession.

text: That's not lead gen. That's free consulting.
style: Suddenly dead serious, low and dramatic, a beat between the two sentences.

text: So I ghost them? Some are good leads.
style: Worried and defensive, a little lost.

text: Ask before you teach. What do you want to fix? Ready to invest?
style: Calm and confident, like a coach giving a simple rule, the two questions said warmly like real DMs.

text: Bro, I can't ask that in every DM.
I can. Plug me into ManyChat. One question at a time. Only the right ones get your calendar, the rest get something useful, like your free guide.
style: Smooth and sly, a beat after 'I can', then an easy, confident offer, rhythmic.

text: So I get my evenings back?
style: Hopeful and surprised, a small smile in the voice.

text: Yeah, stop being a free fucking YouTube channel with a beanie.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug on the last words.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
